topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When I heard the news, I understood it could be tough, but I decided to see it as an opportunity. I thought, why not rebuild those wonderful memories? This time, we can create a bond that’s even stronger, layering new experiences over the old ones. I chose to smile and reach out, not to confront or upset, but to gently remind, through shared laughter and stories, of the friendship that once was and could be again. It’s a challenge, yes, but I’m up for it. I’ll show what it means to be a true friend, one who stands by you even when you don’t remember why.
